tips.text: Buy extra Barrel and Stock relics; Barrel is the Rare in every one and Stock in all but Axi C9.
Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Refine the Rare relics to Radiant and leave the Common ones Intact; Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
